doc.citation: Mehlqvist, K., Steemans, P. and Vajda, V. (2015). First evidence of Devonian strata in Sweden — A palynological investigation of Övedskloster drillcores 1 and 2, Skåne, Sweden. Review of Palaeobotany and Palynology 221, 144–159. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.revpalbo.2015.06.007
doc.comment: Records follow the named Ö2 assemblages and the Ö1 section interval, retaining sample depths and counts where available. A supplementary composite retains collective-only and unprovenanced plate identifications; it is not an independent assemblage. Figure 5A contains fewer taxa than the stated richness totals. The abstract reports 50 samples, whereas methods report 45 from Ö2 plus six from Ö1. Assemblage A is principally assigned to Přídolí but also described as latest Ludlow to Přídolí. Assemblage B includes an uncertain transitional interval. Older-ranging spores in B are interpreted as reworked, although incomplete knowledge of Lochkovian ranges is acknowledged. Prose describing the upper 70 m as spore-barren conflicts with sparse Figure 5A counts. Plate captions contain spelling and identification differences from the species list. Comparisons with earlier papers are not treated as newly sampled assemblages.

items.locality: Övedskloster, directly south of the Helvetesgraven sandstone quarry, c. 10 km NW of Sjöbo, Skåne
items.age_basis_detail: Spore correlation with the Synorisporites tripapillatus–Apiculiretusispora spicula Assemblage Zone; basal tentaculitids independently indicate Přídolí according to K. Larsson, personal communication.
items.notes: The dedicated Assemblage A description and conclusions assign Přídolí; the later interpretation says latest Ludlow to Přídolí. Section 4 initially describes the Přídolían interval as extending to 135.0 m, whereas the named assemblage ends at 145.30 m. Figure 5A supplies 36 taxon columns with occurrences in A. Numerical abundances below are Figure 5A counts by sample depth, not percentages. Plate captions provide no specimen depths; illustrated indicates illustration of the taxon somewhere in the paper, without assigning the illustrated specimen to A. The discussion questions whether the predominantly quadrahedric tetrads at 199.00 m represent Nodospora rather than Tetrahedraletes.

items.age_basis_detail: Incoming Devonian-type spore taxa and comparison with published spore zonations, including Chelinohilates erraticus, Cymbohilates allenii, Chelinospora pseudoreticulata and Cymbohilates microgranulatus.
items.setting_as_reported: shallowing-upward succession; predominantly paralic to fluvial deposits in the uppermost 70 m
items.n_samples: 33 levels in Fig. 5A, including seven without numerical spore entries
items.notes: Includes the 135–130.95 m transitional interval, which lacks taxa clearly indicating Lochkovian age; the firm Lochkovian assignment starts at 130 m. The text reports 73 taxa including the transition and 61 from 130 m upwards, exceeding the identifiable Figure 5A columns. Figure 5A counts are retained by sample depth. Figure 5A has no numerical entries at 35.00, 47.22, 51.61, 55.00, 58.77, 62.18 and 65.00 m. Its sparse counts above 70 m conflict with the abstract's assertion that this upper interval lacks recognisable palynomorphs. Reworking is proposed for older-ranging taxa, particularly Coronaspora cromatica, Chelinospora sanpetrensis, Concentricosiporites sagittarius, Coronaspora reticulata, Confossuspora reniforma, Scylaspora scripta, Hispanaediscus lamontii and Apiculiretusispora cf. A. asperata; incomplete knowledge of Lochkovian ranges is an alternative. The text additionally reports Chelinospora sanpetrensis at 111 m, which is not a Figure 5A sample level. Plate captions lack specimen depths; illustrated refers to illustrations elsewhere in the paper. Concentricosiporites sagittarius is captioned Concentricosisporites sagittarius on Plate II.

items.locality: Övedskloster, directly south of the Helvetesgraven sandstone quarry, c. 10 km NW of Sjöbo, Skåne
items.age_basis_detail: Combined lithostratigraphic and palynofacies correlation with nearby Ö2. The authors explicitly state that dating is not possible from the Ö1 spore content.
items.setting_as_reported: change from marine to terrestrial environment occurs at 88 m
items.notes: Age is indirectly dependent on the spore-dated Ö2 succession. Figure 5B contains 25 taxon columns, exceeding the shorter text list. The sixth, unproductive sample is not assigned a depth in the spore chart. Spores reach 80% of palynofacies counts in the 111–95 m interval; phytodebris dominates 88–75 m. Taxon strings below follow Figure 5B, including Hispanaedisucs lamontii and morph.; the genus field resolves Hispanaedisucs to Hispanaediscus using the text. The prose additionally uses Archaeozonotriletes chulus/nanus, Tetrahedraletes grayii, Imperfectotriletes sp. and Retusotriletes sp.; these are retained here as naming differences rather than additional independent taxa. It qualifies the chart's Cymbohilates hystricosus as Cymbohilates sp. cf. C. hystricosus. Plate captions lack specimen depths; illustrated refers to illustration elsewhere in the paper.

items.age_basis_detail: Collective study age from spore biostratigraphy; individual specimens in the species list and plates are not assigned core depths.
items.setting_as_reported: nearshore marine marls; predominantly paralic to fluvial deposits
items.notes: Supplementary, overlapping composite containing taxa or qualified identifications that cannot safely be allocated to the preceding intervals. Do not count it as additional sampling. Section 7 has 77 entries, including open nomenclature. Plate-only open forms may overlap chart entries, but specimen equivalence is not supplied. Unqualified Apiculiretusispora asperata in the species list is retained separately from the cf. identification in Ö2. The Gneudnaspora variety is specified only in the collective list, with authorship interrupting the taxon string; the full printed entry is retained. Plate IV labels Apiculiretusispora hispidica, whereas Figure 5B and the species list use Aneurospora hispidica; their equivalence is not assumed. Unidentified spore labels and the unassigned tetrad are retained as printed. Reworking is discussed for Ö2, but these unallocated specimens cannot individually be classified as reworked.
